answer.summary: This procedure acts as a wrapper to log a message to the system print file. It passes the program name and text message to a downstream procedure (KBU00008) along with a static status level of 1, which ensures the message is written.

rules.text: The procedure calls KBU00008 with the input program name, input text, and a static status level of 1.
The status level L#STUFE is statically initialized to 1, which prevents the downstream procedure from acting as a no-op (which occurs if status is zero).
